storage: append-only JSONL day-files under <archive>/gridgeneration/, keyed by OBSERVATION day (period date, not fetch date) with event-identity dedup (respondent|period|fueltype) across restarts; gz after 3 days (late hours keep arriving within the lag window)
written_by: server/gridGeneration.ts archiveGeneration (2h poll, 12 politeness-spaced calls/cycle, eager boot; key-gated on EIA_API_KEY — same gate/cadence as the griddemand sibling series)
source: EIA v2 API electricity/rto/fuel-type-data (EIA-930 hourly grid monitor, generation half) — free key, US government public domain. Shape verified live 2026-09-09 (real EIA_API_KEY): hourly net generation per balancing authority x fuel type, value as STRING MWh; bracketed params must be URL-encoded. US48 carries ~16 fuel-type codes/hour (BAT/COL/GEO/NG/NUC/OES/OIL/OTH/PS/SNB/SUN/UES/UNK/WAT/WNB/WND); storage types (BAT/OES/PS/UES) legitimately read negative during charging (confirmed live). Scope v1: same respondent list as griddemand — US48 + CISO/ERCO/MISO/PJM/NYIS/ISNE/SWPP/FPL + SE/NW/SW rollups.
license: US government work, public domain; attribution 'EIA-930 Hourly Electric Grid Monitor'

field_map.respondent|period|fueltype — event-ident: balancing-authority code + UTC hour + EIA-930 fuel-type code; the same observation never re-archives
field_map.fueltype: EIA-930 fuel-type code (COL, NG, NUC, SUN, WND, WAT, storage types BAT/OES/PS/UES, etc.) — raw code as published, not renamed
field_map.mwh: net generation for this respondent+fueltype+hour; missing/empty values are null, never zero; storage types can be negative (charging draws net power)

confidence_model: RAW official hourly generation-by-source.
